description: Get refining and trading spreads: crack spreads (refining margin proxy), basis spreads (regional price differentials), and blending/transport margins. Use when the user asks about crack spreads, 3-2-1 crack, refining margins, basis differentials, or blend/transport margins. Requires an eligible account entitlement. Use opa_get_plans for current access and pricing; the API response is authoritative.

type.description: Spread type: crack (refining crack spread, e.g. 3-2-1), basis (regional/grade price differential), or margin (blending/transport margin).

name: opa_get_spread
title: Get Refining & Trading Spreads
